caption: If you never know what to cook for your baby… start with this 🤍 Salmon Orzo Ingredients: • Butter • 1 small onion, diced • 2 garlic cloves • ½ can tomato sauce • 8 oz orzo • 16 oz water • Handful spinach • 2 salmon filets • ¼ cup heavy cream • Paprika, garlic powder, oregano • Salt & pepper (adjust for babies) Instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in butter. Add tomato sauce, orzo, and water. Cook on low, stirring occasionally. Add salmon halfway through, season, and cover. Cook until orzo is tender and salmon is fully cooked. Stir in spinach and cream. For toddlers: flake salmon and keep seasoning low. — Meals like this are exactly why I created my app 🤍 Because figuring out balanced meals every day can feel overwhelming.
